import re

content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    m = re.match(r'^-\s+(.+?)\s+by\s+(.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        print("Could not parse line:", line)

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for s in old_songs:
    print(s)
